title: Validation error type
hints: `Error()` only formats the two fields. `Validate` is a list of guard clauses, one per row of the table, each returning `&ValidationError{...}`. It ends with `return nil`.
Count characters with `utf8.RuneCountInString`, because `len` counts bytes. For the email, `user, host, ok := strings.Cut(u.Email, "@")` splits at the first `@`, so a second `@` is still in `host`.

Email check: `if !ok || user == "" || host == "" || strings.Contains(host, "@") { return &ValidationError{Field: "email", Reason: "must look like user@host"} }`. Remember the `&`: tests look for a `*ValidationError`.
